<h2>Build a Manuscript Figure Palette</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Returns a colourblind-aware named palette for a supported scientific
semantic domain. Mappings are stable across all main-analysis figures.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>build_manuscript_palette(
  domain = base::c("variance_component", "data_source", "taxonomic_resolution",
    "continent", "availability")
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="domain">domain</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character scalar selecting the semantic palette.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A named character vector of hexadecimal colours.
</p>

</main>
